scenarios.name: double-colorless-unavailable-at-six-lands
scenarios.why: The Shrine plus five other lands is six lands, one short of the stated seven-land threshold.

scenarios.name: double-colorless-offered-at-seven-lands
scenarios.why: The Shrine and six other lands total exactly seven, meeting the restriction's minimum.

scenarios.name: double-colorless-produced-at-seven-lands
scenarios.why: At exactly seven lands the restricted ability is legal, and its resolution adds two colorless mana.

scenarios.name: single-colorless-activates-unrestricted
scenarios.why: The ordinary colorless-producing ability carries no land-count restriction; activating it taps the Shrine and adds one colorless mana at six lands.
